188:t_1:4.en:
$$エイミー$$
「...Wow! That's a whole lot of $$ユンボロ$$s!」

188:t_1:5.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「You don't get it, do you, $$エイミー$$. What's lined up in the $$ラー・カイラム$$ are called mobile suits.」

188:t_1:6.en:
$$アストナージ$$
「$$ピニオン$$! Quit yapping and get your hands moving! We're running out of time!」

188:t_1:8.en:
$$アストナージ$$
「Stop with the 'Boss' thing. Call me Chief.」

188:t_1:10.en:
$$アストナージ$$
「...Forget it... I give up, so just hurry up and work.」

188:t_1:11.en:
$$ランド$$
「All right, let's get to it, $$ピニオン$$. Our job is maintaining the ballute packs, in case of an emergency.」

188:t_1:12.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「You bet, $$ランド$$! Get a good look at the skills of $$ピニオン$$, the man they called the best repairman in $$ガルガンティア$$!」

188:t_1:13.en:
$$メール$$
「Hey, $$アストナージ$$. Honestly, how good is $$ピニオン$$'s skill?」

188:t_1:14.en:
$$アストナージ$$
「I hear the 《$$残されの海$$》 he lived in was a pretty unusual environment. There's no denying his lack of experience.」

188:t_1:15.en:
$$アストナージ$$
「But he's got good instincts. Train him, and he looks like he'll make a fine mechanic.」

188:t_1:16.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Hmm... So $$ピニオン$$ is doing his best too.」

188:t_1:17.en:
$$チェーン$$
「$$ピニオン$$. When you're done over there, please do maintenance on the ASs too.」

188:t_1:18.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Aye, Sis! Leave it to me!」

188:t_1:19.en:
$$アストナージ$$
「As you can see. He adapts pretty well, too.」

188:t_1:20.en:
$$エイミー$$
「That's a relief. We've lived on the sea all our lives, so I was worried about whether we'd fit in with $c.」

188:t_1:21.en:
$$メール$$
「You'll be fine, $$エイミー$$. People from all sorts of worlds are gathered here.」

188:t_1:22.en:
$$ランド$$
「And what's the same in every world is, when you're hungry, you eat. I'm counting on you for another tasty meal today, $$エイミー$$.」

188:t_1:23.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Leave it to me, $$ランド$$.」

188:t_1:24.en:
$$エイミー$$
「You two do your best too, $$レド$$ and $$チェインバー#pilot$$.」

188:t_1:25.en:
$$レド$$
「I'm busy preparing for atmospheric entry right now. Let's have a long talk later, $$エイミー$$.」

188:t_1:26.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Um... I can sort of tell it's really hard work, but what is atmospheric entry?」

188:t_1:28.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Descent to a planet with an atmosphere... can be described as a battle against frictional heat.」

188:t_1:30.en:
$n
「Put simply, it's the heat generated by rubbing against the air.」

188:t_1:31.en:
$$レド$$
「You look awfully tired with the operation coming up, $n.」

188:t_1:32.en:
$$シン$$
「Well, yeah, $$セツコ$$ drilled me hard on solo atmospheric entry simulations.」

188:t_1:33.en:
$$アルト$$
「Still, I'm amazed... I never imagined $$セツコ$$ would be such a strict coach.」

188:t_1:34.en:
$$セツコ$$
「If you cry uncle over this level of training, you'll never move on to the next step.」

188:t_1:38.en:
$$クルツ$$
「I thought you were the pure and innocent type, but you've got it in you, $$セツコ$$.」

188:t_1:39.en:
$$マオ$$
「That Chief who trained you must have been one serious muscleman.」

188:t_1:40.en:
$$セツコ$$
「The best instructor there could be.」

188:t_1:41.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Too bad, $n. After your private lesson with Miss $$スズネ$$, it didn't turn out to be a sweet one-on-one session with $$セツコ$$ as your coach, huh?」

188:t_1:42.en:
$n
「I'm not like you, $$クルツ$$, so I wasn't thinking anything like that.」

188:t_1:43.en:
$n
「I didn't think it would be this hard, though...」

188:t_1:44.en:
$$シン$$
「Don't think you'll always be the only one who gets the good stuff.」

188:t_1:45.en:
$$かなめ$$
「$$シン$$~. If you keep saying stuff like that, I'm going to tell $$ルナマリア$$ on you.」

188:t_1:47.en:
$$宗介$$
「There is a noticeable slackness in morale.」

188:t_1:48.en:
$$マオ$$
「You're right. Want me, Sis $$マオ$$, to tighten up both you and $n mentally, Marine Corps style?」

188:t_1:51.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Hmm... So pilots really do have it tough in all sorts of ways.」

188:t_1:52.en:
$$レド$$
「$$チェインバー#pilot$$... I'd like to go over the procedure once more, too.」

188:t_1:53.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Understood. Ensign $$レド$$, please take your seat.」

188:t_1:54.en:
$$アルト$$
「Hey, hey, $$レド$$. That's not something you need to do.」

188:t_1:55.en:
$$宗介$$
「You're a soldier of the $$人類銀河同盟$$, whose main battlefield is space. You're running an atmospheric entry simulation now, of all times?」

188:t_1:56.en:
$$レド$$
「I... have never experienced atmospheric entry.」

188:t_1:57.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「This unit holds the entry sequence as data, but has no experience executing it either.」

188:t_1:59.en:
$$レド$$
「Yes... To begin with, I had never seen a habitable planet with an atmosphere with my own eyes.」

188:t_1:60.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「The same applies to this unit.」

188:t_1:61.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Is that how it is...? We've fought aliens so many times that I figured the galaxy was full of planets like that.」

188:t_1:62.en:
$$アルト$$
「True, observations say there are nearly 10 billion Earth-type planets.」

188:t_1:64.en:
$$アルト$$
「But whether you can actually get there is another story.」

188:t_1:65.en:
$$アルト$$
「Space is vast. Emigrant fleets like our $$フロンティア船団$$ search for habitable stars across generations.」

188:t_1:67.en:
$$エイミー$$
「So beyond that star there are even more stars, and the sea of space just goes on and on forever.」

188:t_1:68.en:
$$ランド$$
「And in all that wide, wide space, the $$サイデリアル$$ went out of their way to come to Earth, way out in the boondocks of the galaxy.」

188:t_1:69.en:
$$クルツ$$
「No matter how badly they want $$次元力$$, that's a lot of trouble to go to.」

188:t_1:70.en:
$$シン$$
「I've wondered for a while... What do the guys who come to Earth after $$次元力$$ plan to do once they get it?」

188:t_1:71.en:
$$セツコ$$
「...According to $$サルディアス$$, the $$サイデリアル$$ intend to use $$次元力$$ in the fighting at the galactic core.」

188:t_1:72.en:
$$アルト$$
「A battle at the galactic core...?」

188:t_1:73.en:
$$かなめ$$
「They're actually fighting something like that...!?」

188:t_1:74.en:
$$レド$$
「It's true. Hardly any information reaches a low-ranking soldier like me, but...」

188:t_1:75.en:
$$レド$$
「At the galactic core, I hear the $$サイデリアル$$, the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$... and various other forces are clashing.」

188:t_1:76.en:
$$ランド$$
「With ten billion stars scattered across such a vast universe, butting heads like that... What a bunch of idlers.」

188:t_1:77.en:
$$宗介$$
「But suppose they do intend to use Earth's $$次元力$$ in a galactic war. How do they plan to transport it?」

188:t_1:80.en:
$$セツコ$$
「$$サルディアス$$ said the same thing. The $$サイデリアル$$ are collecting $$スフィア$$ to use for transferring $$次元力$$.」

188:t_1:81.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I see... So they'll control Earth's $$オリジン・ロー$$ directly with the $$スフィア$$.」
